text: Teaching Objectives In order to implement the idea of school , and develop “the theoretical basis is strong , the practical ability is stable, the ideological style is simple”, someone who has creating spirit and consciousness for the target, outstanding the character of architecture major, in order to give the majority to the architecture class, some relevant architecture theory as the major class, match with some relevant subject knowledge, focus on the practice teaching and the education of architecture technology. Developing advanced technology talents that meet the needs of socialist modernization; develop in moral, intellectually and physically, and obtain the basis skill of architect as well as doing architectural design,city design, the residential district planning and design, interior design and other research, teaching and managementrelevant subjects. Have the ability of scientific search;Have the ability of design and adapted to work. Duration The basis length of schooling is five years and carry out the flexible schooling system four-seven years. Main Courses Building Construction ONE, History of Foreign Architecture, Basis of Architectural Design, History of Chinese Architecture, Public Architectural Design Principles,Architectural Design SIX, Principle of Residential Building Design,Preliminary Design, Architectural Design ONE, Architectural Design TWO, Architectural DesignTHREE, Architectural DesignFIVE, Principle of Urban Design, Urban Design A, Planning and Design of Residential Area, Architectural Design FOUR, Site Design Principles, Principles of Urban Planning.
